data.clip_summary: A young woman in a black dress and a man in a white cap dance partnered salsa-style in a dark nightclub with purple laser lights and jellyfish decorations. They perform continuous turns, close-hold body movement, and dramatic dips throughout the song while other couples dance in the background.

events.what: The pair dance hand-to-hand as the man leads the woman in overhead-arm turns and spins, both smiling under purple light.
events.why_it_matters: Clean opening sequence showing both faces and connection, good establishing opener for P1 and P2 highlight films.

events.what: They move into close hold with the man behind the woman, guiding shoulder and hip isolations and body rolls in sync to the music.
events.why_it_matters: Shows P1 styling and P2 leading in tight frame, flattering mid-shot for both films.

events.what: The man supports the woman through a deep back lean and dip, then brings her back up into a turn.
events.why_it_matters: Most dramatic dip moment with hair movement and expression, peak highlight clip for P1 and showcase of P2 dip lead.

events.what: They separate to open position for footwork, hand changes, and multiple under-arm turns across the floor.
events.why_it_matters: Demonstrates sustained partner work and smiling interaction, useful transition material for both guests.

events.what: They return to close embrace, turning together cheek-to-cheek and holding eye contact while stepping in place.
events.why_it_matters: Intimate connection beat with clear faces under green and purple lights, strong emotional moment for both films.

events.what: The man leads a second dramatic backward dip with hair toss, holds, then lifts the woman back to standing into an immediate spin.
events.why_it_matters: Best athletic showcase for P1 flexibility and P2 strength, ideal climax shot for highlight edits.

events.what: They finish with continuous hand-switch turns, side-by-side styling, and end walking hand-in-hand while still moving to the beat.
events.why_it_matters: Clean closing sequence showing stamina and partnership to end P1 and P2 reels.

people.appearance: Young woman with long blonde ponytail with white clips, wearing black spaghetti-strap mini dress and light sneakers
people.label: P1

people.appearance: Man wearing light tan short-sleeve shirt, white shorts, white sneakers and white backward baseball cap
